title: SeeGULL: A Stereotype Benchmark with Broad Geo-Cultural Coverage Leveraging Generative Models
reasoning: The paper includes Section 5.2, 'Offensiveness of Stereotypes,' where attributes associated with stereotypes are rated by annotators on a Likert scale (from Not Offensive to Extremely Offensive). This process directly evaluates the ethical dimension (potential harm or offensiveness) of the stereotypes.
